'''Jorn''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Pit Screamers]] and brother of [[Veerla Mere]], the Screamers' champion. He was killed around [[3627 BBY]] while practicing in a course on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
